cohort: 60 patients undergoing elective surgery with ASA Class II and II anesthesia (0.5% bupivacaine) at Khorramabad Nursing Home.
finding: Hearing loss at certain frequencies was observed after spinal anesthesia with 5% Marcaine, but this was not related to age, sex, spinal anesthesia level, or changes in mean arterial blood pressure (MAP) and heart rate.
